name: hop_over_wall
title: One-Time Hop Over an Opponent's Wall (Rule B)
description: Once per game a player may hop over a wall placed by the opponent, stepping into the adjacent cell on the other side. A hop needs an opponent's wall: it cannot be used as a free sprint, over open edges, over pawns, or over the player's own walls. Once used, the hop is gone for the rest of the game.

expect.note: No hop at the start: there is no wall to hop over
Moving next to empty space does not create a hop
Player 1's wall blocks the step forward; Player 0 can hop over it
A second hop is not allowed
